summary: Real connected staging, recovery, and account lifecycle testing has not been completed.
limitations: Accounts and cloud sync must remain disabled in the static build until this gate passes.
requiredChecks: Exact candidate, connected-source snapshot, and production data release bindings
PostgreSQL 18 migration through distinct admin, application, authentication, and share-owner roles
Forced RLS under a non-owner NOBYPASSRLS role with pooled cross-tenant reuse
Magic-link delivery, single use, five-minute expiry, generic responses, and provider failure
Passkey enrollment, authentication, revocation, session rotation, and stable HTTPS RP ID
Append-only review, puzzle, and family-journal replay across at least two devices
Redis quota enforcement and fail-closed behavior during Redis loss
Object-store immutability, private deletion, worker recovery, cancellation, and dead letters
Lichess PKCE, provider 429 cooldown, token encryption, revocation, and disconnect
Account export and recent-authenticated deletion with post-deletion verification
Clean-target backup restoration with measured RPO, RTO, row counts, and integrity digests
Secret-free redacted evidence and complete staging teardown
